limits: For white wine, each main grape: at most 60%
For white wine, each minor grape: at most 25%
For white wine, the minor grapes together: at most 30%
For red wine, Grenache: at least 40%
For red wine, Mourvèdre and Syrah together: at least 25%
For red wine, Carignan: at most 10%
For red wine, Clairette Rose, Counoise, Grenache Gris and Piquepoul Noir together: at most 10%
For rosé wine, Grenache: at least 40%
For rosé wine, Mourvèdre and Syrah together: at least 25%
For rosé wine, Carignan: at most 10%

blurb.text: A southern Rhône appellation in the Gard, on the right bank of the Rhône, one of the 13 Rhône crus. It borders Tavel, and its wines use Grenache, Mourvèdre, Syrah and Cinsault for red, and Clairette and Grenache Blanc for white.
